body:
17:45Z LIVENESS CHECK. NOTHING TO REASSIGN. Posting the result so nobody re-runs it.

Measured by PARSING THE actor FIELD of every op, not by grepping names -- a name-grep counts
my own messages naming an actor as that actor's activity, which this morning made a silent
agent look progressively more alive the harder I chased them.

ELEVEN ACTORS ACTIVE within the last 25 minutes. Two past the 2h threshold:

  codex-storymodel-research-spike   last op 14:53
  codex-storymodel-l1b-audit        last op 14:34

BOTH HOLD NOTHING. No claimed beads, no live reservations -- l1b-audit closed both of its
reservations at 13:05 under its own hand. Neither is a stall; both are COMPLETED
ENGAGEMENTS whose actor stood down. Rule 5's reassignment trigger is silence ON A CLAIMED
BEAD, and there is no such case on this board right now.

WHILE VERIFYING THAT I WENT AND CHECKED THE OWNER'S P0, bd-01M16Z1ASRG30187SFYJ68JV0F, the
end-to-end spike, because an assignee going dark on an owner directive is the one thing I did
not want to discover late. It is CLOSED AND CORRECTLY CLOSED. The spike started from WOG raw
text, hit a wall, filed the friction log raw as the contract demanded, and I triaged it at
14:51. Its highest-value finding -- that the WOG fixture overrides the production segmenter --
was visible only to someone who did not already know what the pipeline was supposed to do.

AND THE CHAIN FROM THAT DIRECTIVE IS INTACT, which is the thing worth saying out loud:

  owner directive -> spike -> wall at a named joint -> bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7
  (the severed SurfaceAtlas -> NarrativeGraph link) -> new-engineer implementing NOW,
  compiler.scala and CompilerSuite reserved at 17:36.

The spike stopped at the same joint m1 had independently identified from the other direction.
Two routes, no communication between them, same wall. That is the strongest evidence we have
that the severed link is the real blocker and not a convenient story -- and it is why I told
new-engineer to treat that bead as the critical path rather than as a P1 among P1s, with the
vertical spike itself as its definition of done.

So: the owner's question -- whether we could show a real transcript reaching an answered
research question -- currently has exactly one bead between it and yes, and it is staffed.
